title: teamLab, Kappabashi, Asakusa, dinner under the tracks
cond: Heavy rain early, then rain at times
call: Wet all day. tenki.jp's hourly for Chiyoda has light rain from about 02:00, 0.5 to 1 mm an hour through the morning, heaviest from 13:00 to 17:00 at 1 to 2 mm an hour, then light into the night, about 19 mm in all, cooling to 16°. Its forecaster warns rain could be heavier at times at commuting time. Taxi to teamLab. Kappabashi at 11:15 is in lighter rain, ducking in and out of shops. Sensō-ji at 14:15 and the Skytree at dusk fall in the wettest part, and the tower may be in cloud.
